question: Test whether an admitted stock-transfer event can load the antisymmetric archive with the shared vertex block live.

objects.definition: Oppositely signed injection into the shared vertex kernel
objects.coefficient_domain: real with exact rational rotation controls
objects.basis_orientation: increasing signed edges with relative copy sign
objects.origin: declared extension of the shared vertex comparator

sources.section_or_object_id: Candidate comparator with a shared live vertex block

assumptions: Two signed-gradient copies sharing identical vertex incidence.
Aligned held odd stock and initially empty antisymmetric receiver.
Separate even matching block and fixed full-stock metric.

technique_plan.technique: Copy symmetry and commuting skew operators
technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: Distinguish admitted common flow from the candidate oriented transfer

clock_receipt.update_rule: first quarter turn then remove the loader

dynamics_readout.state_space: held donor, two gradient copies, shared vertices and separate even block
dynamics_readout.generator_or_update: shared incidence plus declared antisymmetric loader
dynamics_readout.initial_boundary_conditions: positive donor stock and empty antisymmetric receiver
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: skew flow preserves full stock and leaves shared dynamics unchanged
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: J maps into the shared kernel

known_targets: full-load stationary archive and original half-stock readback
fitted_parameters_or_formula_choices: declared quarter turn; no empirical fitting
target_exposure.selection_criterion: stock preservation with unchanged vertex dynamics
target_exposure.baseline: C06 v0.37 two-copy fixed shared generator

result.exact_expression: archive endpoint=(La,-La); readback=||a||^2; donor residue=N cos(theta)^2
result.scope: Common vertex controls and copy-symmetric linear events cannot load the antisymmetric archive. A declared oppositely signed reciprocal transfer loads it with exact stock and half-stock readback.

counterexamples_and_failures: Copy-symmetric events cannot load the empty antisymmetric archive
Continued loader coupling can return the archived stock
limitations: Native opposite-sign reciprocal coupling, copy identity and endpoint selection remain open
next_discriminant: Search for a source-defined oriented second copy and independent reciprocal connection with deterministic endpoint selection.
